Paths are normalized to forward slashes before matching.
This list REPLACES the script built-in defaults when non-empty.

Use for files that are UNUSUAL to commit but occasionally legitimate.

softPatterns.hint: PlantUML diagram source. Usually not committed (generated/visualized locally). Confirm this file is intentionally version-controlled.
Log file. Should be in .gitignore. Confirm this is not an accidental staging.
Build output directory. Confirm this artifact is intentionally source-controlled (e.g., pre-built release asset).
Test coverage output. Should not be committed. Confirm this is intentional.
.env file may contain secrets. Secret scan already ran, but confirm this file is safe for version control (e.g., .env.example only).
